h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Purnia

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Purnia

items.pText: How many children will be on the playground at the same time? That is the first question we ask buyers in Purnia, and it matters more than the size of the ground. A school that sends a whole class out together needs a very different set of equipment from a housing colony where a few children play at a time.

FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 1,660 km from Purnia in north-east Bihar. We send it by road, and our installation team or a dealer in the region installs it. This part of Bihar is humid and gets a heavy monsoon, so we suggest galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic. Tell us how many children will use the area at once, their age group and the size of the space, and we will mark the safe play area on a layout drawing.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Planning equipment by the number of children

c: Count play positions, not pieces. A single slide keeps one child busy at a time, while a
with steps, decks and two slides can occupy many. A
takes four children, and a multi see-saw takes several.

For a class at break, aim for enough positions that no child waits long. For a colony, a few well-chosen pieces are enough. Leave the safe play areas clear even when the ground feels crowded. Squeezing pieces together to fit more children is where most accidents start.

facts.label: Delivery and installation

items.q: How much equipment does a school in Purnia need?
items.a: It depends on how many children play at once. Tell us the class size at break and the age group, and we will suggest enough play positions for that number.

items.q: Can we place equipment closer together to save space?
items.a: No. Each piece needs its own safe play area. We would rather suggest a larger multi play system than crowd separate pieces into a small ground.

items.q: Do you deliver to Purnia, Katihar and Kishanganj?
items.a: Yes. We dispatch by road from Vasai to north-east Bihar, and our installation team or a dealer installs the equipment.
